comparison.objective: Extract one connector terminal; record processes and discards a diagnostic swab.
comparison.physical_skill: Single-blade tab release versus deep swab insertion, sustained tube squeezing, counted rotations, and squeezed rotating withdrawal.
comparison.success_condition: Selective terminal removal without damage versus five valid turns, continuously squeezed extraction, bin disposal, and hand clearance. Candidate force/damage thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: The record tests deformable-container force maintenance and rotational counting, not rigid retained-part extraction.
